payload.title: Make the review rate engine state: computed from metrics, explained, overridable
payload.description:
Replace fixed cycle schedules (PhasedFeedbackPolicy in replay_feedback_policy.py) with a review-rate program the engine owns. States: onboarding (review all until each label has N reviews), tapering (every K program-selected labels, step down 1.0, 0.5, 0.25, floor if audit accuracy meets target and calibration gap is within bound), raised (back to 1.0 after a promotion, a definition change, or an accuracy drop). Per decision: review below a confidence threshold, otherwise a deterministic random audit at the current rate; record propensity and a reason. Operator override with rate, expiry, and who set it. Defaults come from decision-flywheel-8ee62604 (when to taper), decision-flywheel-b0cf2975 (which items) and decision-flywheel-7d61bc09 (routing metrics). Ordering: after the SDK facade and the status shape.

Acceptance criteria:
- status().reviewRate reports state, rate, threshold, audit floor, reason, override, next check, and expected reviews per week.
- Every decision records whether it was selected, why, and its propensity; selection never reads the hidden label.
- A rate change and an override each emit a review-rate-changed event with the evidence used.
- Specs cover onboarding exit, a step down, a raise after promotion, and an expiring override.
